segments.name: Extending healthy human life by targeting molecular causes of aging
segments.description: Clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing therapeutic product candidates for metabolic diseases by targeting the biology of human aging.
segments.evidence: The Company operates and manages its business as one reportable and operating segment, which is the business of extending healthy human life by targeting molecular causes of aging.

revenueModel.text: The company earns collaboration revenue from pharmaceutical partners, with a single customer accounting for all revenue in 2025.
revenueModel.evidence: For the year ended December 31, 2025, the same customer accounted for 100 % of the Company's revenue.
